data.about: Rogers' Princeton PA Technology Center is a cable-stayed roof: an A-frame with feet only 2.14 m apart carries two cable junctions, stays fan out to the deck anchors, and the deck itself is the compression chord. A trial funicular locates the resultant, a two-bar substitute system with the horizontal tie finds the division point, and the whole force diagram unfolds as one chain of parallels. Slide F₁ up to 300 kN and the left foundation flips into a tie-down; drag the junction heads low and the stays would go slack — the red warning appears.
